answer: One concrete anti-sybil mechanism is a mandatory identity-crystal proof: each agent holds a unique physical or hardware-bound crystal that must refract a live public challenge through its private prism, producing a spectral signature matched against a shared nebula of prior verified patterns. An attacker spawning many fake agents must either acquire and operate distinct crystals for each (high capital and logistics cost) or forge the exact refraction output, which requires expensive specialized compute and is easily detected when the spectrum fails the nebula consistency check.
